description: This PHP source file defines the LicenseAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, providing REST API endpoints and logic for managing license resources such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting licenses in the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: LicenseAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for license management, including retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting license records, with integrated validation rules and service interactions.

methods.name: getLicenseService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the LicenseService instance used to perform business logic related to licenses.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific license by ID, returning a LicenseModel encapsulating the license data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, specifically requiring a positive integer ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a collection result of all licenses, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing licenses, mainly for sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new license record based on request parameters and returns a resource result.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Assigns license name from request data to License entity and persists it via the service.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a license, primarily checking the name parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing license record identified by ID, applying new data from the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a license, including ID validation and unique name constraint.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the license name, ensuring required, string type, length, and uniqueness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple licenses specified by IDs in request body and returns the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, mainly checking for presence of IDs in the request.
